name: Apollo 15 CSM
about: Apollo 15 CSM (1971-063A), a crewed vehicle (Apollo II), launched 1971 Jul 26. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1971 Jul 26), held fixed
docked to S05366; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
